annotations.title: List bookable property services (certificates, trades, professionals)

description: List the types of property service that can be booked through the OpenMoov marketplace — safety certificates (gas safety/CP12, EICR, EPC, PAT testing, legionella, fire risk), trades (plumber, electrician, heating engineer, drainage, locksmith, roofer, pest control, cleaner, gardener, handyman, decorator), listing services (photography, floorplans, inventories) and professionals (conveyancing, surveying, removals, mortgage advice). Optionally filter with a free-text query (e.g. "gas certificate", "boiler") or a category slug. Returns each service type's slug, name, category and responseModel — "fixed_price" means a published price the user can pay now, "quote_first" and "call_out" mean the trade responds with a price. Professional services sold through their own flow (conveyancing, mortgage advice) carry bookVia naming the tool to call and a url instead — do not pass their slug to search_services. alsoSearchableAs lists an older slug for the same service that search_services also accepts (some providers list against it). This is the CATALOGUE and needs no location; call search_services with a UK postcode to find the actual providers, prices and availability near the user. Note the two are different vocabularies: responseModel here describes the service TYPE, while search_services reports each listing's priceBasis (fixed, hourly, call_out_plus, package, property_size) — do not read one as the other.

category.description: Category slug to filter by, e.g. "gas_safety", "plumbing", "electrical", "cleaning"

query.description: Free-text filter on name, description and tags, e.g. "gas safety" or "EICR"
